channel.description: Channel through which the OTP is delivered

context.description: Business scenario for which the OTP is generated

recipient.description: Target recipient of the OTP (email or phone number)

code.description: One-time password code sent to the recipient

validationAttempts.description: Number of unsuccessful OTP validation attempts

maxValidationAttempts.description: Maximum allowed failed validation attempts before OTP becomes invalid

resendCooldownSeconds.description: Time (in seconds) the user must wait before requesting the OTP again

maxRequestsPerDay.description: Maximum number of OTP requests allowed per recipient and context per day

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the OTP expires (ISO format)
